purpose: One feature change (mouth shape, eyes, brows) or one turn of the whole character (its drawings by angle) of a neutral bust, for cutting into Rigger template parts.
whenToUse: after qwen_bust_face: sixteen passes, prompts from `rig_parts.py --prompts`
a 2.5D rig on a full turnaround: three more (`--prompts --turnaround full`)
a re-roll of one variant whose edit drifted
whenNotToUse: expressions as finished art (it changes one feature only)
a neutral that is not 1024x1024 on a plain background
gotchas: the reference is the neutral bust, never another variant
a turn (turn_3q_r …) turns head and shoulders together and keeps the neck in place: `_r` faces the picture's right
one side's turns alone: cut with `--mirror` for the other
